This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which 
 must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
 title block.

The perkins CV12 is four stroke turbocharged direct 
 injection compression ignition liquid cooled engine with air charge cooling 
 the 12 cylinders are arranged in two banks in a 60 deg (V) configuration the 
 diesel generator in normal operating condition of the power unit is 
 automatically started and connected to switch board item
 CJ-QP01 CJ-QP02 in case of lack of power voltage on its busbar the diesel 
 generator is rated to cover the electic power demand of the auxiliaries that 
 are to be kept operating

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Ahmad 
 Abd-Elrady Mohamed ,accepted by eng. Abd-Elkarem Mosa Ahmad , approved 
 by eng. Yosef Mahmod Ali general manager of Esna power station and
 certified by eng. Mohamed Osama 
 Soliman: HPGC quality general director & MPIS coordinator
Cooling system : radiator pack engine pipe work thermostat

Fuel system : injection pump feed pump fuel injectors fuel 
 filters

Lubrication system : sump, oil pump, pressure relief valve, 
 oil filters

items: Cooling system : radiator pack engine pipe work thermostat

Fuel system : injection pump feed pump fuel injectors fuel 
 filters

Lubrication system : sump, oil pump, pressure relief valve, 
 oil filters
Induction system : air cleaners, turbocharger

A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc
The unit should be off position

Maintenance is carried out with 
 cooperation with electrical department

Mechanical tools 
 ( complete set of manual wrench - brushes - etc)
Blanco 1 ton

Tighten hexagonal screw with atorqe 
 wrench

Check the (coolant water lubricating oil fuel) level with the correct grade 
 (upper mark on the dipstick)

Check each air cleaner restriction indicator if red sleeve is visible the air 
 cleaner element has reached the limit of fouling and must be serviced 
 immediately reset the indicator by pressing the button in its top
Check the control linkage for freedom and range of movement

Check the induction and exhaust system and the radiator are free from 
 obstruction
Check the oil pressure at rated speed
Check the condition and tension of fan and alternator driving belts
Every 12 moths drain cooling water system and renew coolant mixture
Every 12 moths drain lubricating oil system and renew oil filter canisters

Every 12 moths replacement filters (oil fuel air) with anew filters and O ring 
 ring in the stem groove

Check the turbocharger securing nuts tightness and check for freedom of 
 rotation and listen for sound of rubbing may indicate bearing wear cleaning 
 and bearing checks
